style: Avant-garde vocal-percussion art-punk. Harsh dry acoustic textures with bitonal modal drones and shifting reference pitches. High-energy motorik pulse with asymmetric footstep/stomp stamps. Akan-leaning phonology governs prosody; lexical tone and laryngeal glottalization determine melodic contours. Timbre: hand claps, finger snaps, footsteps, group stomps, mouth clicks, lip pops, breathing, pneumatic air. Structure: Leader plus distorted echo group, hyper-articulate nervous phrasing. Performance: Trashy cheap spectacle played straight under extreme fight-or-flight panic-under-function pressure. Sub-bass kinetic sub-oscillations fracture the room response while glass-shatter transients punctuate the dry stereo field. Microtonal pitch bending scrapes against rigid metronomic foot stomps, instilling mechanical dread within the raw acoustic chamber while feedback loops warp the spatial geometry across every transient edge.

caption: A high-friction art-punk spectacle driven by vocal-percussion and obsessive phonetic rules. The music utilizes a binary competing-pitch system and a leader/echo topology to enact a state of functional panic. Phonology is governed by Akan-leaning prosody, with lexical tone and laryngeal glottalization acting as primary drivers of melody and orchestration. The arrangement relies on dry body-percussion, pneumatic air, and repetitive structural mutations to embody the seed's agitated demand.
